Maria (sec-eng): Heads-up: planning a compact base-image rebase this Thursday 02:00 UTC. Goals: remove setuid, tighten seccomp, add cosign provenance. Need RBAC for KMS signing, small audit webhook, and a verified rollback plan.
Raj (platform-sre): I'll scope IAM. We should grant only cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the specific cryptoKey to builder SA + signer-operator. Will add an IAM condition to bind to the key resource.
Kevin (infra): Confirming KMS path: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-signer. Use Cloud KMS (not HSM) for this roll.
Maria (sec-eng): Audit retention: staging 90d, prod 365d. Audit event name: image.signed with fields {kms_key, signer, digest, build_id}. Raj can the builder POST that?
Raj (platform-sre): Yes. I'll add a tiny build step to POST /audit-intake and include sample payload in the PR. Also will attach the terraform RBAC diff.
Nate (runtime): Runtime requirements: verify cosign provenance on startup; if verify fails, log verification.failure=true, revert to pinned base v1.7 for 5m, and trigger a PagerDuty alert. Need example cosign command in docs.
Kevin (infra): Docs snippet I'll add: cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/image-signer gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:fff111
Maria (sec-eng): Action items: Raj -> PR for IAM + webhook; Kevin -> cosign + rotation runbook; Nate -> staging canary and failover test; I'll run vuln scan post-rebuild and check audit events. Tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled: base-image-rebase -> Thu 02:00 UTC; canary=10%; rollback_enabled=true.
